description:
## Problem
After the SSB and synthetic cutovers the legacy Python generators are dead weight.

## Change
Remove the legacy SSB and synthetic generators and their --datagen-backend legacy entries.

## Decision gates
- Time gate: one minor release after the later of the two cutovers (set not_before then).
- If any published result still needs a legacy generator to reproduce inside the supported window, stop and ask the owner.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree; heavy work only through make heavy-run; never kill processes by name pattern.
- No divergent fork of tpcgen-rs; carried patches only under the 2026-11-27 rule (<= ~200 changed lines, upstream PR, SHA pin, README entry); anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first.
- Human commit identity, no agent attribution. Report only observed results.
